title: Adversarial review
activation: a finished deliverable or decision is about to be committed to
a load-bearing design, boundary, dependency, migration, or public claim needs breaking before trust
standDown: the draft is still in motion
the work is low-stakes and reversible
the ask is line-by-line code review
inputs: the request in the person's own words
the project constitution when one exists
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: a verdict of rejected or needs validation returns the deliverable to its author with the failure mode named
